contracts.name: Active SKU Checkout Price
contracts.description: Live checkout price must match business catalog price for SKU-AURORA-PRO-X exactly.

contracts.name: Mandatory Customer Legal Disclaimer
contracts.expected_value: Terms apply. All sales final on promotional bundles. 30-day limited warranty included.
contracts.description: Customer experience legal compliance disclaimer must be present, visible, and unmodified.

contracts.name: Legal Disclaimer Minimum Font Legibility
contracts.description: Legal disclaimer font size must be at least 11px to satisfy statutory readability requirements.

contracts.name: WCAG AA Contrast Compliance (Legal Text)
contracts.description: Text contrast ratio against background must satisfy WCAG AA 4.5:1 minimum threshold.

contracts.name: Strikethrough Reference Price
contracts.description: Original reference comparison price must match promotional contract ($39.99).

contracts.name: Discount Badge Promotion Consistency
contracts.description: Discount badge must advertise the verified 38% reduction.

contracts.name: Primary Checkout CTA Visibility & Actionability
contracts.description: Checkout button must be rendered visible with non-zero dimensions and opacity.
